\begin{exercise} \end{exercise} 1. ch5:5-9

Suppose $(M, g)$ is a Riemannian manifold and $(U, \varphi )$ is a smooth coordinate chart on a neighborhood of $p \in M$ such that $\varphi (p) = 0$ and $\varphi (U)$ is star-shaped with respect to $0$. Prove that this chart is a normal coordinate chart for $g$ if and only if $g_{ij}(p) = \delta _{ij}$ and the following identity is satisfied on $U$: \[ x^i x^j \Gamma ^k_{ij}(x) \equiv 0. \] \end{exercise}
